tools.name: rug_check
tools.description: Rug-risk report for Solana tokens (also Base ERC-20 via 0x address): mint/freeze authority, risky Token-2022 extensions, top-holder concentration, DEX liquidity/volume/pool age, 0-100 risk score, one-line verdict and a shareable report page URL. Heuristic, not a guarantee. Costs 0.02 USDC per call v

tools.name: tx_explain
tools.description: Solana transaction explainer: status, fee, signers, programs invoked (named), and per-account SOL and token balance changes in plain JSON for any mainnet signature. Costs 0.01 USDC per call via x402 (Solana or Base).

tools.name: token_info
tools.description: Solana token market snapshot: USD price, market cap, FDV, liquidity, holder count, supply, 5m/1h/6h/24h price change and volume, organic score, verified flag and tags, for any Solana mint. Costs 0.005 USDC per call via x402 (Solana or Base).

tools.name: base_token_risk_check
tools.description: Base token risk check for any Base ERC-20 0x address: owner/renounced, EIP-1967 proxy/upgradeable, mint/pause/blacklist/fee-tax/max-tx functions in bytecode, DEX liquidity/volume/pool age, 0-100 risk score, one-line verdict and a shareable report page. Heuristic (no honeypot simulation), not a guara

tools.name: rug_check_lite
tools.description: FREE trial (5 calls/day): quick risk score, risk level and one-line verdict for any Solana mint or Base ERC-20 0x address. Use rug_check for the full flags report + shareable page.

tools.description: Free sample rug-risk report (BONK) showing the output format of rug_check.
